note: Survey 선택과 무관하게 출제되는 돌발 주제입니다. 항목을 추가하려면 같은 형식으로 topics 배열에 넣으세요. type 값: description, routine, pastExperience, memorable, comparison, problemSolving, issue, askQuestions

questions.text: Tell me how people recycle in your country. What kinds of items are separated, and how is the trash collected?
Describe how you recycle at home. What do you do with plastic, paper, and food waste each week?
Tell me about a time when you made a mistake while recycling, or when you learned something new about recycling.
How has recycling in Korea changed compared to the past? What new rules or habits have appeared?
Some people say individual recycling is not enough to solve the waste problem. What do you think companies and the government should do?
Describe the public transportation in your city. What kinds of transportation are available, and which one do you use the most?
Tell me how you usually get to work or school. Describe your trip from your home to your destination.
Tell me about a memorable or unexpected experience you had while using public transportation.
Compare the public transportation of today with what it was like when you were a child.
What problems do people face with public transportation in big cities, and how could they be solved?
Tell me about a piece of technology that you use every day. What is it, and how do you use it?
Tell me about the first time you used a computer or a smartphone. How did you learn to use it?
Tell me about a time when a piece of technology stopped working when you really needed it. What did you do?
How has technology changed the way people communicate compared to ten years ago?
Some people worry that technology like artificial intelligence will replace many jobs. What is your opinion?
What environmental problems are people in your country concerned about these days? Describe one of them in detail.
What do you do in your daily life to protect the environment? Tell me about your habits.
Tell me about a time when you experienced an environmental problem yourself, such as bad air or extreme weather.
Compare people's attitudes toward the environment today with those in the past.
Who do you think is most responsible for solving environmental problems: individuals, companies, or governments? Explain your view.
Describe a bank in your neighborhood. What does it look like, and what services does it offer?
What do you usually do when you go to the bank? Or do you do your banking online? Tell me about it.
Tell me about a time when you had a problem at a bank or with a banking app. What happened?
How has banking changed over the years? Compare banking in the past with banking today.
Describe the weather and the seasons in your country. Which season do you like best, and why?
What do people in your country usually do during the summer or winter? Tell me about seasonal activities.
Tell me about a memorable experience you had because of extreme weather.
How has the weather in your country changed compared to when you were young?
Tell me about a major holiday in your country. When is it, and what do people do on that day?
How do you usually spend holidays with your family? Describe what you do from beginning to end.
Tell me about a holiday that you especially remember from your childhood.
How have holiday traditions changed compared to the past?
Tell me about the home appliances you have at home. Which one is the most useful to you, and why?
Tell me about a time when one of your home appliances broke down. What did you do?
Compare the home appliances people used in the past with the ones people use today.
Describe a restaurant you like to go to. What kind of food does it serve, and why do you like it?
When do you usually eat out, and who do you go with? Describe your typical experience.
Tell me about a memorable meal you had at a restaurant.
How have eating habits in Korea changed recently, for example with food delivery apps?
What do people in your country do to stay healthy? Tell me about some popular healthy habits.
What do you do to stay healthy? Describe your eating, sleeping, and exercise habits.
Tell me about a time when you were sick or injured. What happened, and how did you recover?
Many people today suffer from stress. What causes it, and what do you think people can do to reduce it?
Tell me about the websites or apps you visit most often. What do you usually do on them?
Describe how you usually use the internet during a typical day.
Tell me about a time when you found really useful information on the internet.
What are some problems caused by the internet, such as fake news or privacy issues? How can people protect themselves?
Describe the neighborhood you live in. What kinds of buildings and places are there?
What do you usually do in your neighborhood? Tell me about the places you often visit.
Tell me about a memorable experience you had with one of your neighbors.
How has your neighborhood changed since you first moved there?
Describe the kind of clothes people in your country usually wear. What is popular these days?
How do you usually decide what to wear in the morning? Tell me about your style.
Compare the fashion of today with the fashion from ten years ago.
Describe the geography of your country. Are there many mountains, rivers, or beaches?
What do people in your country like to do outdoors because of the geography, like hiking or going to the beach?
Tell me about a natural place in your country that you visited and found impressive.
Tell me about your favorite piece of furniture at home. What does it look like, and why do you like it?
Tell me about the last time you bought furniture. Where did you buy it, and how did you choose it?
Compare the furniture in your home now with the furniture you had when you were a child.
What do people in your country usually do in their free time? Describe some popular activities.
Compare how you spent your free time when you were in high school with how you spend it now.
Some people say Koreans do not have enough free time because of long working hours. What do you think?
